title: Geo‑anchoring primitives for hosted inference: pin sets, soft‑affinity, retention policies, and attestable evidence bundles
creator: Marco Nguyen
description:
Problem: Customers need deterministic controls for where customer data (request payloads, embeddings, KV caches, logs) are stored and processed in Hosted API, plus automated, auditable evidence that residency and retention policies were honored. Current residency features are limited to coarse region pins and manual evidence exports, which complicates compliance with customer contracts and audits.

Goal: Design and implement a flexible geo-anchoring primitives set for tenants and API routes that supports: (1) hard locks (no cross-region processing), (2) soft-affinity with controlled fallback sequences, (3) per-tenant and per-route retention profiles with automatic expiry, and (4) periodic attestable evidence bundles (signed manifests + traces) that can be exported to customers or legal/compliance teams.

Scope: API surface (REST + Console), operator controls, runtime routing integration (smart routing hooks), automated evidence generation pipeline, and docs. Out of scope: Proprietary on-prem orchestration (handled by Private team).
acceptance_criteria: Tenants can create pin sets that specify ordered region preference and hard-lock booleans for Hosted API
Per-route overrides supported via API and Console with precedence rules documented
Retention profiles configurable per-tenant and per-route with automated deletion workflows and retention audit logs
Evidence bundles produced on-demand and on-schedule (daily/weekly) containing signed manifests, routing traces, policy decisions, and proof of deletion where applicable
Console displays residency compliance status and recent evidence exports with download links
Telemetry: per-tenant/route metrics for cross-region fallbacks, pinned-region violations, and evidence export success rate
Operator playbook for emergency relaxation (temporary soft-affinity) with audit trail
implementation_notes: Routing: add 'pin_set_id' and 'pin_mode' to tenant config. Runtime smart-router must evaluate pin_set and fallback chain before model variant selection. If 'hard_lock' is true and preferred region unavailable, return 503 with structured error containing evidence token for later attestation.
KV cache residency: anchors to serving pool in primary region. Cross-region cache warming allowed only with 'soft_affinity' and explicit consent.

Evidence bundle: assemble signed JSON manifest + compressed traces (gz) + retention-change diffs. Sign with tenant token and platform HSM key. Store bundles in s3-backed evidence-bucket with immutable object lock for retention window.
Retention enforcement: retention policies drive automatic 'expiry jobs' that remove persisted customer artifacts and emit deletion receipts into audit log.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Hard-locks reduce availability if regional capacity constrained. Mitigation: Provide simulation tools in Console to preview SLO impact and recommend pre-reserved Dedicated if necessary.
Risk: Evidence bundle might leak PII if traces contain payloads. Mitigation: Default evidence bundles to policy 'metadata-only'; allow opt-in 'full-traces' after security review and DPA amendment.
Risk: Legal requirement heterogeneity across customers. Mitigation: Build evidence formats with interchangeable modules and versioning for jurisdiction-specific fields.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (beta): API + Console for pin sets and retention profiles for 10 pilot customers (managed rollout), daily manual evidence export
Phase 2 (GA): Automated scheduled evidence bundles, UI for download and webhook delivery, support for soft-affinity fallbacks and per-route overrides
Phase 3: Integrations for signed attestations (customer KMS verification), and Marketplace/DPA templates
qa_and_testing: Integration tests simulating region outage and asserting fallback metrics and evidence tokens produced
End-to-end test with tenant retention policy applied and subsequent verification that deletion receipts exist
Penetration test on evidence bundle generation path and HSM signing endpoints
